title: Langs test
list: [a, b]

# Langs

```
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><style>body { color: red; } /* c */</style>
<script>const x = `a${1}`; function f(a, b) { return a + b; } // js</script></head>
<body class="x"><?php echo "hi"; $a = [1, 2]; ?> <% puts "erb" %></body></html>
$ echo "hello" && ls -la | grep md
>>> print("repl")  # python
def f(x: int) -> str: return f"{x}"
key: value # yaml
- [1, 2, "three"]
SELECT id, name FROM t WHERE x = 'y'; -- sql
{"a": 1, "b": [true, null]}
fn main() { let v: Vec<u8> = vec![]; println!("{}", v.len()); }
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { printf("%d\n", 42); return 0; }
FROM node:20
RUN npm ci && echo done
Get-ChildItem -Path . | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 }
@echo off & set X=1
```

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><style>body { color: red; } /* c */</style>
<script>const x = `a${1}`; function f(a, b) { return a + b; } // js</script></head>
<body class="x"><?php echo "hi"; $a = [1, 2]; ?> <% puts "erb" %></body></html>
